name: form-field
gotchas: A form field expects exactly one form-field control inside it (matInput, mat-select, etc.) — wrapping more than one, or none, is a supported-but-broken layout, not a runtime error, so the label/underline positioning just silently looks wrong.

`<mat-error>` only renders once the control has been marked `touched`/`dirty` (or its parent form has been submitted) and is `invalid` — a common mistake is expecting it to appear immediately when the control becomes invalid programmatically.

`appearance="outline"` vs. the default `"fill"` changes expected padding/height assumptions across a form — mixing appearances between fields in the same form usually indicates a missed default rather than an intentional choice.
